failures.generatedSql:
WITH first_order AS (
  SELECT c.customer_unique_id,
         MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS first_ts
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
),
cohort AS (
  SELECT customer_unique_id
  FROM first_order
  WHERE first_ts >= '2017-01-01' AND first_ts < '2017-07-01'
)
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cohort), 2) AS retention_rate
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-07-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01'
  AND c.customer_unique_id IN (SELECT customer_unique_id FROM cohort)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
LIMIT 100;

       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN st.resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (st.resolved_at - st.created_at)) / 3600 <= tc.sla_hours THEN st.ticket_id END)
             / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN st.resolved_at IS NOT NULL THEN st.ticket_id END), 2) AS sla_rate
FROM support_tickets st
JOIN ticket_categories tc ON st.category_id = tc.category_id
GROUP BY tc.category_name
LIMIT 100;
